_meta._note: MAI-Cyber-1-Flash (Microsoft, 2026-07-27). NEW model: cybersecurity-specialized fine-tune of MAI-Code-1-Flash (137B total / 5B active MoE, 256k ctx), derived from the MAI-Thinking-1 lineage. Proprietary, Azure AI Foundry Private Preview, access restricted to select MDASH customers (dual-use). Ingested ONLY the Model-Only External Cyber Benchmark Results table (single model, lightweight terminal harness) — a clean primary source. Card fractions (0.314 etc.) x100 to match existing cvebench/exploitgym %-scale on the dashboard. NOT ingested: CyberGym 88.4%->95.95% is an MDASH SYSTEM score (100+ agents, MAI-Cyber-1-Flash + GPT-5.4), not a MAI-Cyber-1-Flash single-model score -> excluded under strict attribution. MAI-Thinking-1 (109p report, Tables 11/12) re-checked: all benches already covered by its existing 38 scores -> no net-new.
